findings.summary: ADR 0006 item 6 records token-types 6.2.0 as BSD-3-Clause. The installed package, its LICENSE.txt and pnpm licenses report MIT. music-metadata 13.0.1 itself is recorded correctly as MIT; all eight runtime dependencies are MIT; no install scripts.
src/renderer/components/artwork/artwork.tsx line 5: the doc comment contains a line feed in place of the 'n' of 'null' ('or <LF>ull for the placeholder'). No behavior impact.
playlist:load resolves up to 5000 saved paths sequentially and parses each file with duration:true, which can delay the first paint of a large playlist. Not measured.

playlist.json is trusted input. A hand-edited UNC path on Windows would be stat'ed and parsed, which can open an SMB connection. Requires local write access to the user-data directory; extension and file checks still apply. Not exercised against a real network.
The OGG fixture is Ogg-encapsulated FLAC, not Vorbis. No Vorbis or Opus encoder is available offline. The .ogg path is verified, the Vorbis codec is not.
